description.value: Thai Basil is a Thai restaurant established in 2008 with four Vancouver locations, including this one on Commercial Drive — a popular cycling corridor in the city's east side. The menu spans curries, noodle soups, salads, and rice dishes with a range of protein choices including tofu. Cyclists can dine in or order takeout for a convenient mid-ride meal.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: rack at 70m; rack at 86m; rack at 99m.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content confirms this is the Commercial Drive location of a four-location Thai restaurant chain; the address (1179 Commercial Drive, Vancouver, BC V5L 3X3) and a location-specific phone number (604) 428-3050 are listed on the Locations page, corroborating the OSM address. The website explicitly advertises 'order to go at your convenience' and delivery, confirming takeout. Tofu and vegetarian salad/curry options appear throughout the menu, supporting a vegetarian-friendly designation. No bike parking, washroom, Wi-Fi, or water-refill information appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no phone number; phone (604) 428-3050 sourced from website Locations page for the Commercial Drive branch only — contact_confirmed.phone set to null.

Website domain's front-page title reads 'Thai Basil Restaurant - Broadway', suggesting the canonical homepage may be anchored to the West Broadway location rather than Commercial Drive; however, the Locations page clearly lists and distinguishes all four branches.
OSM name is 'Thai Basil'; full business name on website is 'Thai Basil Restaurant'.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate food stop on a busy cycling corridor, but no bike parking, washroom access, or water refill information could be confirmed — all three required WWC criteria are unverified. A site visit or direct contact to confirm at least bike parking and washroom access is recommended before including.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu includes vegetarian options throughout: Deep Fried Tofu, Mixed Veggie Salad (coconut lime sauce), and all curries offered with tofu as a standard protein choice
